units.source_text: 乳母向二条院借一辆车子，来到常陆守的邸内，把昨日之事从头至尾报告了夫人。

en.t: The nurse borrowed a carriage from Nijo-in, went to the Hitachi Governor's residence, and reported everything that had happened the day before to his wife.

units.source_text: 夫人大为吃惊，心肝都摧折了。

en.t: The lady was terribly shocked, and her heart felt utterly crushed.

units.source_text: 她想：“侍女们一定看不起我的女儿，在那里讥评了。

en.t: She thought, "The serving women must have looked down on my daughter and criticized her there.

units.source_text: 亲王夫人又不知作何感想。

en.t: And who knows what the prince's wife must have thought?

units.source_text: 争风吃醋之事，贵人也是一样的。”

en.t: When it comes to jealousy in love, even highborn people are no different."

units.source_text: 她推己及人，便觉焦灼万状，刻不能待，就在当天傍晚来到二条院。

en.t: Judging others by her own feelings, she became unbearably anxious and could not wait a moment, so she went to Nijo-in that very evening.

units.source_text: 恰巧匂亲王不在家，可以放心。

en.t: Fortunately, Prince Niou was away from home, so she could feel at ease.

units.source_text: 便对二女公子说道：“我把这幼稚无知的孩子寄托在府上，原是很可放心的。

en.t: She said to the Second Princess, "When I entrusted this young and ignorant child to your household, I thought I could feel completely reassured.

units.source_text: 然而总是心挂两头，坐立不安。

en.t: Yet my heart is always pulled in two directions, and I cannot sit or stand in peace.

units.source_text: 家里那些无知小儿也都在怪怨我呢。”

en.t: Even those foolish children at home are all blaming me."

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“并不像你所说那样幼稚。

en.t: The Second Princess replied, "She is not as childish as you say.

units.source_text: 你不放心，神色仓皇地说这些话，倒教我不好意思了。”

en.t: Seeing you so worried and flustered as you say such things makes me feel embarrassed instead."

units.source_text: 说罢莞尔而笑。

en.t: After saying this, she smiled gently.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人看了她那安详稳静的神色，由于心中怀着鬼胎，局促不安起来。

en.t: Seeing the Second Princess's calm and composed expression, the Hitachi Governor's wife, burdened by her own guilty thoughts, grew awkward and uneasy.

units.source_text: 她不知道二女公子究竟如何想法，一时话也回答不出。

en.t: She did not know what the Second Princess was really thinking, and for a while she could not answer.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“能在这里侍奉小姐，多年来的愿望就满足了。

en.t: At last she said, "If my daughter could serve you here, my long-standing wish would be fulfilled.

units.source_text: 外间说出去也好听，真是有面子的事。

en.t: It would sound well to the outside world and would truly be an honorable thing.

units.source_text: 然而……毕竟还是有所顾虑。

en.t: And yet... after all, I still have misgivings.

units.source_text: 终不如照原来的打算，让她闭居在深山中修行，倒是最可放心的。”

en.t: In the end, it would be safest to follow the original plan and have her live secluded in the deep mountains to practice religious discipline."

units.source_text: 说到这里哭泣起来。

en.t: At this point, she began to weep.

units.source_text: 二女公子也觉得可怜，对她说道：“在这里有什么不放心呢？

en.t: The Second Princess felt sorry for her too and said, "What is there to worry about here?

units.source_text: 如果我冷淡她，样样事情都不管她，那是自不必说了。

en.t: If I treated her coldly and neglected her in every matter, that would be another thing.

units.source_text: ……这里原有一个心地不良的人，常常会做出不成样子的事情来。

en.t: ...There is indeed someone here with a bad nature who often does disgraceful things.

units.source_text: 然而大家都熟悉其人的脾气，处处用心提防，决不会让你女儿吃亏。

en.t: But everyone knows that person's temperament well and is careful everywhere, so we will certainly not let your daughter suffer any harm.

units.source_text: 不知道你对我是怎样猜想的。”

en.t: I do not know what suspicions you have about me."

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人答道：“不不，我决不会疑心您冷淡。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife replied, "No, no, I would never suspect you of being cold to her.

units.source_text: 已故八亲王怕没面子，不肯认浮舟为女儿，这也不必再提了。

en.t: The late Eighth Prince refused to acknowledge Ukifune as his daughter because he feared losing face, but there is no need to mention that again.

units.source_text: 但在另一方面，我和您原有不可分割的血统关系。

en.t: On the other hand, you and I have an inseparable bond of blood.

units.source_text: 赖有这点缘分，我才敢把浮舟拜托您照顾。”

en.t: It is only because of that connection that I dared to entrust Ukifune to your care."

units.source_text: 这话说得非常恳切。

en.t: She spoke these words with great earnestness.

units.source_text: 最后又说：“明日和后日，是浮舟的严重的禁忌日，因此想带她到僻静的地方去闭居。

en.t: Finally she added, "Tomorrow and the day after are serious days of abstinence for Ukifune, so I would like to take her to a quiet place for seclusion.

units.source_text: 改天再来拜望。”

en.t: I will come to pay my respects another day."

units.source_text: 说罢便带着浮舟回去。

en.t: After saying this, she took Ukifune and went home.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得事出意外，不胜怅惘，但也不挽留她。

en.t: The Second Princess felt this was unexpected and was deeply disappointed, but she did not try to keep her there.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人被昨天的怪事吓坏了，心绪不宁，匆匆告辞而去。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife had been badly frightened by the strange events of the day before, and with her mind unsettled, she hurriedly took her leave and went away.
